regime_context: The detector shows a broad but not one-narrative Canada/TSX state: Oil & Gas Producers lead on absolute trend (eligible, durability 0.69, breadth 0.93) with a wide margin over Big Banks. Eight of 16 themes are eligible, absorption is low (0.31), and the backtest verdict confirms momentum is an attention lens only, while the absolute-trend gate is the lone validated risk-control edge. Track record is decent on hits but directional accuracy is poor (0.316), so conviction stays low.
emerging_watch: Watching Utilities & Renewables (XUT.TO): eligible with the strongest durability_bar (0.78) of any theme and a clean trend tag, yet negative momentum (-0.05) and uncrowded (z -0.47). The observable to watch: if XUT.TO gains relative to XEG.TO over two consecutive weeks while its durability_bar stays above 0.70, the watch strengthens; if XUT.TO makes a lower low, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO is the only theme with a decisive trend-gate pass (eligible, durability 0.69 — below trend-health threshold but positive) paired with exceptionally high breadth (0.929), meaning the advance is broad rather than single-stock. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated leg here, and it is positive. Crowding (z 1.18) is a size-down caution, not a fade. Durability is mixed-trend rather than strong-trend, which keeps conviction low.
evidence: gate_helps: true on this market — trend discipline has historically reduced drawdown
theses.dissent: Oil & Gas is crowded (z 1.18) and the leading theme on momentum — the documented failure mode is treating the leader as a return forecast when rank-IC is ~0. Its durability is only mixed, not strong-trend, so the trend gate could flip within days.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO prints a lower low while its durability_bar drops below 0.45 before the 20-day check-by date.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: ZEB.TO shows the strongest trend-health among eligible scorable themes (durability_bar 0.71, hurst_tag 'trend') with healthy breadth (0.857) and no crowding (z 0.44). The rotation gap to Oil & Gas is wide (1.393), so this is not a confirmed handoff — only a durable secondary trend in its own right.
theses.dissent: Banks sit second on momentum with a large margin behind Oil & Gas; the rotation radar is display-only with no validated forward edge, so there is no signal that leadership is actually rotating to financials.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags XEG.TO by more than 5% cumulatively and its durability_bar falls below 0.45 before the 20-day check-by date.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: XIT.TO is eligible with a trend-tag and reasonable breadth (0.80) but is the most crowded scorable theme (z 1.35) while its momentum score is slightly negative (-0.03). Crowding is a size-down caution; combined with a near-zero score, it argues against adding exposure here. This is an underweight lean, not a short.
theses.dissent: Tech is the macro-dominant narrative (ai_tech appears in recent macro flow), and a trend-tag with decent breadth could mean the crowding reflects genuine momentum that persists — underweighting the macro favorite can underperform.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO closes above its 20-day high while its crowding_z falls back below 1.0 before the 20-day check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
